name: ninjaone-mcp
description: Every NinjaOne report, plus a local store that answers fleet-wide questions no single API call can: patch compliance, backup gaps, AV blast-radius, health, drift.

ninjaone_client_id.title: NINJAONE_CLIENT_ID
ninjaone_client_id.description: OAuth2 client_id from NinjaOne Administration > Apps > API.

ninjaone_client_secret.title: NINJAONE_CLIENT_SECRET
ninjaone_client_secret.description: OAuth2 client_secret from NinjaOne Administration > Apps > API.

ninjaone_oauth_scope.title: NINJAONE_OAUTH_SCOPE
ninjaone_oauth_scope.description: Sets NINJAONE_OAUTH_SCOPE for the NinjaOne MCP server. Required by the generated client for credential refresh or hand-written auth flow.

ninjaone_base_url.title: NinjaOne API base URL
ninjaone_base_url.description: Base URL for the NinjaOne API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

ninjaone_token_url.title: OAuth2 token URL
ninjaone_token_url.description: Token endpoint the client-credentials exchange posts to. Leave the prefilled default unless your tenant uses a different token endpoint.

ninjaone_no_config_write.title: Keep credentials off disk
ninjaone_no_config_write.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to config.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

ninjaone_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
ninjaone_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

ninjaone_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
ninjaone_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

ninjaone_mcp_upload_root.title: MCP upload folder (optional)
ninjaone_mcp_upload_root.description: Optional. Leave blank. Reserved for MCP file uploads: no NinjaOne MCP tool in this release takes a file, so the server never opens a local path and this setting has no effect.

ninjaone_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
ninjaone_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on NinjaOne requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

ninjaone_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
ninjaone_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
